_meta_itemized.notes: RE-FILED UNCHANGED. This Post-Election report is the SAME PHYSICAL SHEET as Margaret Olson's Pre-Election filing 8193, photocopied and re-submitted: identical three contribution rows, identical four expense rows, identical handwritten 858.19 box, identical cover (900.00 / 858.19 / 41.81). That is the documented Summit re-file behaviour (Robinson, Wright, Jones, Olson, Francis), not a duplication defect - the two filings were read and transcribed independently and both are published. Handwritten entries on the printed 2018 grid; the OCR text layer is noise, so both ledger pages were read full-page at 200 dpi with one 900 dpi tight crop (p3 band 6) as the geometry spot-check, which reproduced '3/9/18 | Filing Fee | County Clerk | 781.08'. BOTH printed template specimen rows survive unstruck (Jon and Jane Doe $435.00, Name of Business $512.00) and both totals close only without them. THE CONTRIBUTION SHEET'S ENTIRE DATE COLUMN IS EMPTY - three donors with amounts, addresses and zips but no dates at all; honest blanks (needs_review=1), never back-filled from the report date. Privacy: only city/state kept from the Mailing Address column; no separate state column is printed, so state is read off the written city ('SLC', 'Idaho Falls', 'PC') and never off the zip. The last expense line's cells are SEMANTICALLY SWAPPED - the 900 dpi crop shows 'Filing Fee' sitting inside the Person-or-Organization column and 'County Clerk' inside the Purpose column - and are assigned by meaning here.
